SELECT
    h."id" AS hotel_id,
    h."name" AS hotel_name,
    h."address" AS hotel_address,
    c."name" AS city_name,
    CASE
        WHEN lf."feature" = 'Swimming Pool' THEN 'Swimming Pool'
        WHEN lf."feature" = 'Hot Tub' AND c."name" = 'New York' THEN 'Hot Tub'
    END AS feature_type
FROM
    "hotel" h
JOIN
    "city" c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
JOIN
    "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
JOIN
    "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
JOIN
    "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
WHERE
    lf."feature" = 'Swimming Pool'
    OR (lf."feature" = 'Hot Tub' AND c."name" = 'New York')
GROUP BY
    h."id", h."name", h."address", c."name", lf."feature";

WITH tourist_attractions_portobello AS (
    SELECT
        v.id AS visitor_id,
        v.name AS visitor_name,
        t.name AS tourist_name
    FROM
        visitrecords vr
    JOIN
        visitors v ON vr.visitorid = v.id
    JOIN
        tourists t ON vr.touristattractionid = t.id
    WHERE
        LOWER(TRIM(t.activity)) = 'tourist attraction'
        AND LOWER(TRIM(t.location)) = 'portobello'
),

local_markets_portobello AS (
    SELECT
        v.id AS visitor_id,
        v.name AS visitor_name,
        t.name AS tourist_name
    FROM
        visitrecords vr
    JOIN
        visitors v ON vr.visitorid = v.id
    JOIN
        tourists t ON vr.localmarketid = t.id
    WHERE
        LOWER(TRIM(t.activity)) = 'local market'
        AND LOWER(TRIM(t.location)) = 'portobello'
)

SELECT
    ta.visitor_name AS tourist_attraction_visitor,
    ta.tourist_name AS tourist_attraction_name,
    lm.visitor_name AS local_market_visitor,
    lm.tourist_name AS local_market_name
FROM
    tourist_attractions_portobello ta
FULL OUTER JOIN
    local_markets_portobello lm ON ta.visitor_id = lm.visitor_id
ORDER BY
    COALESCE(ta.visitor_name, lm.visitor_name);

        cc.id AS company_id,
        br.role_id

        construction_companies_building_roles ccbr ON cc.id = ccbr.construction_company_id
    JOIN
        building_roles br ON ccbr.building_role_id = br.role_id
),
role_counts AS (
    SELECT
        role_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) AS company_count
    FROM
        company_roles
    GROUP BY
        role_id
),
total_companies AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total
    FROM
        construction_companies
)

FROM
    role_counts rc
JOIN
    building_roles br ON rc.role_id = br.role_id
CROSS JOIN
    total_companies tc
WHERE
    rc.company_count = tc.total;
